what_this_is: Cluster-bootstrap intervals for the comparison of Section VI.C. Each replicate resamples the eight task templates and recomputes every validator on the same clusters, so a paired difference does not inherit the variance the validators share. Eight clusters give wide intervals, which is a property of this benchmark and not of the method.

recompute + trace only - recompute.what: la composition contre la recomputation seule
